subject: Initial discovery: Caldera Systems — coordination and availability
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ashley Nguyen <ashley.nguyen@caldera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial discovery: Caldera Systems — coordination and availability

Hi Ashley —

Thanks for the intro over LinkedIn last week. Wanted to get a short (30–45m) discovery on the calendar so we can understand Caldera's top priorities, current infra footprint, and security/procurement timeline. Suggested agenda:

- 10m intros + champion context
- 15m architecture / infra + pain areas
- 10m compliance/POC constraints (SOC2, data routing)
- 5m next steps / mutual action plan

Are any of the slots below workable for your team next week (PST)? If none, send a couple of options and I’ll try to align Steph (SE) and Ben (Solutions) as well.

• Tue Apr 6 — 10:00–10:45am or 2:00–2:45pm
• Wed Apr 7 — 11:00–11:45am or 3:30–4:15pm
• Thu Apr 8 — 9:00–9:45am

I’m attaching a one-pager scope doc to help the internal team prep.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: discovery_scope_v1.pdf (PDF)]
From: Ashley Nguyen <ashley.nguyen@caldera.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Praveen Gupta <praveen.gupta@caldera.com>, procurement@caldera.com
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: Caldera Systems — coordination and availability

Hi Naomi —

Thanks — good agenda. Quick scheduling note: Praveen (engineering lead) is only available on Wed or Thu mornings. Procurement asked to be included for initial timeline visibility. From your list, Wed Apr 7 11:00am PST works best for us. Could you add a short pre-read for procurement (SOW / pricing ballpark) if possible?

Also copying security@caldera.com — they may have a couple of SOC2 questions up front.

—Ashley
Ashley Nguyen
Director of Product | Caldera Systems
ashley.nguyen@caldera.com | +1 (415) 666-2244

Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: Caldera Systems — coordination and availability

Perfect — Wed Apr 7 11:00–11:45am PST is reserved on our side. I’ve added Ben (solutions) and Steph (SE) so we can cover architecture and an initial runbook for a POC.

Per procurement’s ask, attaching a short SOW template and a pricing ballpark slide (high level only) — these are meant for planning, not a finalized offer.

Attachments: caldera_sow_template.docx; discovery_scope_v1.pdf

I’ll send the calendar invite once you confirm Praveen can make that time. If Praveen prefers a different morning time, let me know and we’ll adjust.

Thanks,
Naomi
[Attachment: caldera_sow_template.docx (DOCX)]
From: Ashley Nguyen <ashley.nguyen@caldera.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Praveen Gupta <praveen.gupta@caldera.com>, procurement@caldera.com, security@caldera.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: Caldera Systems — coordination and availability

Hi all —

Quick update: Exec scheduling conflict — Praveen is no longer available Wed 11am due to a leadership all-hands that moved earlier. Sorry about the scramble.

We can do one of the following instead:
• Wed Apr 7 — 9:30–10:15am PST
• Thu Apr 8 — 11:00–11:45am PST

Also security asked whether Redwood has a recent SOC2 Type II report and whether the demo will involve any production data. They’d like a brief note ahead of the meeting.

Apologies for the churn — Ashley
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ashley Nguyen <ashley.nguyen@caldera.com>
Cc: Praveen Gupta <praveen.gupta@caldera.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood-inference.com>, procurement@caldera.com, security@caldera.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: Caldera Systems — coordination and availability

Thanks for the heads up, Ashley — no problem. We can do Wed Apr 7 9:30–10:15am PST; that slot works for Steph and Ben.

To answer security’s question: Redwood has a SOC2 Type II report (most recent: Q4 2026). The discovery/demo will use anonymized staging data only — we will not access Caldera production. I’m linking to our compliance folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2-reports.

I’m attaching the short one-pager that summarizes compliance & data handling for customer previews. Please treat the SOC2 as restricted for procurement/security review.

I’ll send the calendar invite once you confirm the Wed 9:30 slot.

Best,
Naomi
[Attachment: compliance_onepager.pdf (PDF)]
From: Ashley Nguyen <ashley.nguyen@caldera.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Praveen Gupta <praveen.gupta@caldera.com>, procurement@caldera.com, security@caldera.com
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: Caldera Systems — coordination and availability

Hi Naomi —

Confirmed for Wed Apr 7 9:30–10:15am PST. Praveen and procurement are good to join. Security has the SOC2 link and will review ahead of the call.

Could you please include a 10–15 min block at the end to walk through a simple mutual-action plan (deliverables, owners, timing)? Procurement wants visibility into next steps.

If you can send the invite to calendar and include the drive link + attachments, we’re set. Thanks for being flexible.

—Ashley
